facts.fact: BusinessDay reports Telkom's Openserve has completed a third redundant long-haul fibre route between Cape Town and Pretoria via Springbok and Mahikeng, alongside two existing routes between the two cities; no length given. As of is the article's published date, as no completion date is given.

BusinessDay reports Openserve, Telkom's wholesale infrastructure unit, runs South Africa's largest wholesale fibre network (about 180,000km), delivering high-capacity connectivity to licensed operators and enterprises. As of is the article's published date.
